name: clinic-scheduler
description: Clinic appointment scheduler: patients, providers, slots, booking and cancellation.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run test -w web
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
